patch_description: This design retains the permutation-equivariant collective input mixer and depth-efficient K8 perfect-matching schedule that performed well in the prior candidates. Its novel change concentrates additional expressivity at the measurement interface: the former single RX output rotation is replaced by a shared RX–RY–RX Euler ladder following the collective RZ layer. The three independently trained angles let each re-upload block expose multiple phase-coherence quadratures to the fixed mean-Z readout without adding two-qubit gates or breaking qubit-permutation symmetry. Parameter sharing keeps the block at six parameters, while independent block copies preserve the temporal flexibility of data re-uploading.
